description: Generic enrollment right on a certificate template; prerequisite edge for the ESC abuse chains.

telemetry.detail: Certificate request logged on the CA - benign in isolation; enrollment is a normal operation.
Enrollment alone is common and low-signal; risk materialises when combined with a vulnerable template (ESC1-8).

abuse_primitive: Enroll; abuse potential depends on the template's ESC posture.
notes: Scored low because plain enrollment is legitimate. Pathing through it only becomes dangerous when it reaches a vulnerable template edge (ADCSESC1).
